Class MultipartReader

java.lang.Object
io.micronaut.http.form.MultipartReader
All Implemented Interfaces:
Closeable, AutoCloseable
public final class MultipartReader extends Object implements Closeable
A blocking, streaming reader of a multipart/* body (RFC 2046, RFC 7578) that works on any InputStream and does not depend on a transport.

Parts are read in order with next(); the body of a part is streamed by MultipartReader.Part.body() and is only valid until the next call to next(), which skips what is left of it. Nothing is buffered beyond one read buffer, so the MultipartReader.Limits bound the memory and the input the reader accepts: the number of parts, the size of the headers of a part, the size of the body of a part and the size of the whole body. Exceeding one throws a ContentLengthExceededException; a malformed body throws an IOException.

Instances are not thread-safe.

Since:
5.3.0
